notes.title: Update Notes for July 7th, 2021.
notes.notes: Fixed a bug found inside the cave section that was mentioned by one review of the game.

notes.title: UPDATE FOR 25th OF APRIL
notes.notes:
The game now has [b]full controller support[/b]. You are able to play the entire game with Playstation or Xbox controllers. Hopefully this'll make for a better experience for some of you who didn't enjoy the keyboard and mouse controls!

Good luck playing!

notes.title: Quiet Thoughts is available for play now!
notes.notes:
[i]Quiet Thoughts[/i] is available to be played right this second!

As it's main developer, I sincerely hope you enjoy it and have a good time playing it! Feel free to contact us and tell us everything you liked and disliked about it here: radultec@gmail.com, so that we can try and fix it. 

Thank you and have fun playing!

notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes:
[b]Quiet Thoughts free Demo is out now![/b]

The demo features the very beginning of the main game and should take around half an hour to complete, depending on player's past experience with precision platformers.

I sincerely hope you enjoy it and find it fun. If you do, wishlisting [i]Quiet Thoughts[/i] would help other players see and eventually enjoy it as well.
